name: pey.filesystem
description: User-device file access as a platform capability over a swappable environment adapter (browser File System Access today): pick files/folders, list Markdown entries, read and write; browser-side shadow drafts for unsaved device edits. After deactivation or shutdown every method refuses with SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

provides.name: pey.filesystem.service
provides.description: Markdown-focused file-entry operations over the plugin's environment adapter (BrowserEnvironmentAdapter by default, selectable by configuration). Entries carry either a FileSystem handle or a plain File; picked entries carry a minted rootId that gives same-named folders distinct shadow-draft identities.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Reports which environment pickers exist and whether picked entries may be writable (handle-backed ones can be; a write can still be refused by the permission round-trip).
methods.returns: { directoryPicker: boolean, filePicker: boolean, writable: boolean }

methods.name: pickDirectory
methods.description: Opens the environment directory picker. Null when no picker is available or the user cancels. The returned entry carries a minted rootId — pass the entry (not the label) to the shadow methods to keep same-named folders distinct.
methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemDirectoryHandle, rootId: string } | null

methods.name: pickFile
methods.description: Opens the environment file picker. Null when no picker is available or the user cancels. The returned entry carries a minted rootId.
methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemFileHandle, rootId: string } | null

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Walks a picked directory recursively through the environment adapter and returns every Markdown entry with its relative path and own file handle. Flat list; other files are skipped. The walk is depth-capped, skips well-known infrastructure folders (.git, node_modules) and unreadable subfolders, and comes back in stable path order.

params.name: directory
params.type: object — picked directory entry ({ name, path, handle, rootId }) or a raw directory handle

methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemFileHandle }[]

methods.name: collectEntries
methods.description: Shapes a flat file list (e.g. from a webkitdirectory input) into entries and keeps the Markdown ones. Paths are normalized relative to the picked root (the leading folder segment of webkitRelativePath is dropped), matching listDirectory. Pure service-side data shaping — no environment capability involved.

params.name: files
params.type: Array<File-like> — each with name, text() and optional webkitRelativePath

methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, file: File-like }[]

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Reads entry text through the adapter (with a read-permission round-trip) or its plain file. Strips a leading byte-order mark.

params.name: entry
params.type: { name: string, path: string, handle?: FileSystemFileHandle, file?: File-like }

methods.name: writeEntry
methods.description: Writes content through the entry handle (with a readwrite-permission round-trip). A failed write or a failed close fails the operation and aborts the stream, so no half-written file commits; the original failure rides in the error detail. Null when the entry has no writable handle — the caller falls back (e.g. to a download).

params.name: entry
params.type: { name: string, path: string, handle?: FileSystemFileHandle }

methods.name: saveShadow
methods.description: Persists a browser-side working copy of a device entry (disk bytes untouched): the disk content at open (base) plus the current draft. The first argument is preferably the picked entry — its minted rootId keeps same-named folders distinct; a plain folder label string also works. Requires the host to configure a pey.storage store named 'disk-drafts' with keyPath 'key' (see docs/reference.md).

params.name: rootOrEntry
params.type: object — picked entry ({ rootId, name, ... }) or string folder label

params.name: base
params.type: string — disk content the draft started from

methods.returns: { root: string, path: string, updatedAt: number }

methods.name: readShadow
methods.description: Reads the stored working copy for an entry, or null when none exists. Drafts stored before 1.1.0 (label-keyed) are still found.

params.name: rootOrEntry
params.type: object — picked entry ({ rootId, name, ... }) or string folder label

methods.returns: { root: string, path: string, base: string, draft: string, updatedAt: number } | null

methods.name: clearShadow
methods.description: Deletes the stored working copy (e.g. after an explicit disk save made it redundant). Deleting a missing draft is a successful no-op.

params.name: rootOrEntry
params.type: object — picked entry ({ rootId, name, ... }) or string folder label
